args: Replacement separation measurement, without movement or reopening. Validate the SAME undamaged rigid rectangular cream-cheese package and the semantics and adequacy of the saved full-face diagonal and thickness bounds using pick_reference. Do not inherit the failed narrow-patch angular gate. Request f0..f5 spread widely in BOTH directions across the currently visible planar printed face, excluding fingers, seams and background; t0..t3 widely separated on the same tabletop near the package; p0..p3 at the supplied persistent graphic landmarks; floor at the visible bowl interior bottom. Give two pixels at the complete exposed SHORT top-face end edge, and eight distributed pixels on the actual INNER bowl opening boundary, not the outer rim. Boundary pixels can be ray-intersected with independently measured planes. List any falsely sampled names in surface_exclusions. Report each semantic field separately; later corridor questions may be unknown. On attempt 2 request only missing or genuinely replacement measurements, using another camera or better-spread patch for the failed evidence. Valid supplied same-frame points will be explicitly merged; validate their surface membership and retain their physical identities. Do not repeat an unchanged narrow fit.

labels: p0: apex of thin blue outline above capital C in Cream
p1: center of light oval inside right curl of capital C
p2: center of light counter of lowercase e in Cream
p3: center of light counter of lowercase a in Cream

extent_bounds.source: retain_gate historical bound, to be validated against pick_reference; not an external constraint

pick_reference.provenance: Visible depth planes, identified projected top boundary, measured own geometry. Pixel/depth allowances and contact margins are operational heuristics.

current_contact.provenance: Dimensions and normals are historical, freshly checked for stationarity; plane offsets are current depth. Own bounds and pose are measured. All allowances and the unchanged 3 mm side/4 mm table minima are operational heuristics, not external constraints or calibrated confidence bounds.

prior_hold_failure.gate: Stationary closure hold or command failure
prior_hold_failure.threshold_provenance: Operational heuristics unless explicitly labeled measured geometry or runtime budget.

post_closure_contact.provenance: Current closed geometry; 3/4 mm minima and allowances are heuristics. Upward test only; no new hold, descent or closure.

result.explanation: The visible printing, straight margins and exposed short end support identity with the cream-cheese package in pick_reference. No deformation or damage is visible; hidden surfaces are not inspected. The saved 0.0811203 by 0.040338 m full face has a diagonal of approximately 0.0905961 m, so the 0.0945961 m bound covers that full face with allowance, not merely the currently visible patch. The 0.0209709 m thickness bound is the original table-supported height 0.0179709 m plus allowance, not the current tabletop separation. These bounds remain supported under the unchanged rigid rectangular-package model; the occluded full extent is not freshly measured. f0-f5 and printed_face_region span both directions on the planar printed face, excluding seams and fingers, and replace the narrow normal fit. t0-t3 sample the same visible tabletop. p0 is the outline apex above C; p1 is the light oval in the right C curl; p2 and p3 are the light counters of e and a. The edge pixels mark the complete exposed short boundary of the printed top face. The eight rim pixels follow the inner opening boundary, avoiding its robot-occluded rightmost segment; floor samples the visible interior bottom. No slip is indicated by the supplied tracked co-motion measurements; closed fingers alone do not establish retention. Earlier images are not supplied here, so bowl stationarity cannot be independently compared. No movement, reopening, placement or completion is certified.

parameters.hazards: The gripper self-occludes the near portion of the package, finger contacts and part of the bowl's right rim. The package underside and some rear geometry are unobserved. These are visibility limitations, not observed external obstructions. This stationary replacement measurement does not assess later transport or placement corridors.
